subject: Important Update: Changes to our Privacy Policy
body: Dear valued customers, We wanted to inform you about some recent updates to our privacy policy. These changes are aimed at improving transparency and protecting your personal information. We encourage you to review the updated policy on our website to understand how your data is being used and protected. If you have any questions or concerns, please do not hesitate to reach out to our customer support team. Thank you for your continued trust in our services.
